description: Use this when the user wants Xenition to remember material so it can answer from it later — pasted notes, a policy, an article, or a public web page link (e.g. 'save this pricing page so I can ask about it'). Saves it privately to their knowledge; ask_workspace and their agents then answer from it with sources. Text or a web page only; PDFs and Word files are uploaded in Xenition. Do not use to create a document (use the document tools) or to answer a question now (use ask_workspace).

text.description: the material itself, pasted — notes, a policy, an article. Give text OR url, not both

title.description: a short name for it, e.g. 'Pricing policy 2026'; the page title is used for a link if omitted

url.description: a public https web page to save instead of pasted text

name: add_to_knowledge
title: Save to your knowledge
